The best match is **ammonia, urea and creatinine**. Of the two options, I choose this one because creatinine is a metabolic end product, whereas creatine is not. My earlier answer (ammonia, hypoxanthine, uric acid) described the purine pathway more directly. Ammonia from AMP deamination is the link that holds in both versions. I'm not certain about the creatinine part, because it comes from creatine breakdown rather than ADP breakdown.
